| diversity-dividend-384 | leaderboard | 22 | exploratory | Results | Both named claims of the diversity-dividend test are confirmed at the preregistered 20m buffer. Per the preregistered H3 analysis plan (analysis-summary.md: 'compare voted F1 vs single-pass mean F1' + 'threshold sweep curves showing optimal (N, threshold) combinations'), the headline is each configuration's BEST (N, threshold) operating point against the known test-tile ground truth -- the study's purpose is to characterise how well VLM symbol extraction localises mounds, so best-achievable performance is the deliverable, not a confound. Method: round-robin tile-swap permutation (10k perms, seed 42, two-sided; BH-FDR q=0.05) + greedy-clique tiering over a 22-cell board (4 consensus champions + 18 single-pass cells); 197/231 pairs significant -> 7 tiers. (1) DIVERSITY DIVIDEND -- HIGH-thinking consensus significantly exceeds minimal-thinking consensus at matched modality: text +0.153 F1 (BH-p<0.001; MCC +0.239) and image +0.070 F1 (BH-p<0.001; MCC +0.272). The HIGH-thinking pools take the larger consensus gain -- more varied proposals let a high vote threshold prune their false positives. (2) CONSENSUS vs SINGLE-PASS -- every consensus champion significantly beats its matched within-pool single-pass baseline (+0.13 to +0.43 F1, all BH-p<0.001), and the lift persists at the production N=5 operating point (text 4-of-5, image 3-of-5; +0.09 to +0.33 F1). (3) CROSS-ARCHITECTURE HEADLINE -- Tier 1 (the tie_set) is a THREE-member statistical tie: the best Flash HIGH-text consensus (F1 0.814) and the two genuine-Gemini-3-Pro single-pass text leaders (pro-text-high-t-0-0 0.804, pro-text-medium-t-0-0 0.792); the permutation cannot separate Flash-consensus from the Pro leader (p=0.616, BH-p=0.66). Cheap Flash consensus reaches the expensive Pro single-pass tier on localisation F1. OPERATING-POINT SENSITIVITY (characterised, co-headlined): the Tier-1 parity is at the best (N, threshold) point (26-of-30); at the production N=5 carry-forward point (text 4-of-5) the same pool reaches TIER 2 (0.720), tying genuine Pro text at T=0.7 -- a best-minus-N5 delta of ~0.094 F1 (the within-test cousin of the carry-forward-vs-best delta the 55-map generalisation reports). F1-parity is NOT MCC-parity: the Pro text leaders are more tile-precise (MCC 0.790, 11 tile FPs) than the Flash consensus champion (MCC 0.620, 41 tile FPs) -- the metric-dependent-winner pattern of the n1 board persists. Deployment generalisation to unseen maps is the separate question answered by the 55-map runs. Era-2 487-tile test scope, 384px, gemini-3-flash. CLEAN ISOLATION (hold architecture x modality x thinking x temperature constant, vary only size): single-pass text climbs monotonically with tile size (256=0.342 < 384=0.520 < 512=0.606) -- with no FP filter, larger tiles give cleaner proposals; single-pass image is flat (384~0.600 ~ 512~0.586). CONSENSUS+VERIFIER head-to-head (View 3; Stage-D carry-forward adversarial verifier, gemini-3-flash minimal T=0.0 n=1; 14-buf+MCC; best prob_t per cell): 384=0.890 > 256=0.856 > 512=0.793 -- best=384px (delta +0.034 over 256).
